svg.title: Wrap in callout
svg.desc: An Obsidian note with a Markdown table selected, and the command palette searching wrap: Callout Studio's Wrap in callout, Wrap in Idea block callout (collapsed) with a custom Command-Shift-C shortcut, and Unwrap from callout.
